subject: The secret feature 90% of users skip until week 3
preview_text: I wasn't going to send this, but you've been using the app for 22 days and still haven't tried this one thing.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. When I was building Fresh Start, I almost left this feature out. I thought it was too raw, too real. I thought people would find it too intense. But then I tested it with the first 100 users. And something wild happened.

The people who used it reported their 3AM spiral moments dropped by over 60% in the first week. They stopped texting their ex 'by accident.' They stopped checking their socials. They told me it felt like having an emergency brake for their heart. And you've had it sitting in your pocket this whole time.

It's the Emergency Mode. Not just the button—the deep protocol. The one that doesn't just distract you, but actively rewires the panic in real-time. It's the difference between drowning in the memory and building a raft out of it. Most people find it by accident. Or they wait until they're desperate. But the hack is to use it BEFORE you think you need it.

Open the app right now. Tap the shield icon. Set up your Emergency Protocol. Do it today, not at 3AM tomorrow. P.S. The first user who tried this told me it saved her from sending a text that would have set her healing back by months. That text is still unsent.
